setup.context:
The retry worker in acme/app currently waits a fixed 250 ms. The relevant code is already in context: runWithRetries in src/retry.ts loops and calls sleep before each retry, and retry.test.ts uses a fake clock. Decisions are settled: use exponential backoff with full jitter, cap the delay at 30 seconds, and stop after five attempts.
Complete relevant source follows:
export async function runWithRetries(work, sleep) { for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { try { return await work(); } catch (error) { if (i === 4) throw error; await sleep(250); } } }
retry.test.ts injects a fake sleep and records every delay.
